pages.ld_description:
Freely explore your environmentally friendly modular architectural designs with  Arckit's reusable components while learning all about what goes into building a modern, sustainable & energy-efficient home.
Note: Wall finishes on packaging models are not included in the kit, however they are freely available to print off online from our Arckitexture library.
 
Arckit GO Eco is an accredited STEAM toy.
The GO Eco building kit comes with:
 

117 Arckit pcs. (Architectural building blocks)

Arckitexture decals available to print off online (including white louvres, light timber, dark brick and vegetation). We recommend using clear electrostatic printable paper or easy peel printable paper (compatible with your specific printer) for easy application and removal on your Arckit models.
30 x Arckit cardboard pop-outs (including wind turbine, solar panels, water harvestation tank, air-source heat pump, figurines, trees & furniture). Add more cardboard pop-outs


Features a pitched roof design set. 

1 x Introductory booklet with instructions for 1 design, reusable box. 
A further 3+ alternative building design instructions are available online as well as lots more printable Arckitexture decals and Arckit inspiration.
Arckit Digital components are also available to build via SketchUp and Tinkercad platforms. 
Package dimensions: 340x220x60mm
Recommended for age 10+
